name: context-bar
description: Shows the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category; /context-bar toggles it

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: Show a second row naming the largest categories and their tokens

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh during a turn
refreshSeconds.description: Re-measure after a tool call at most this often, in seconds (the bar always updates when a turn ends)
